THE SMALL PRINT

Good questions
get good answers.

Are classes live or recorded?+

Classes are live and interactive. That’s where the good conversations happen. We’ll share any useful follow-up resources after the session.

Do I need experience?+

Not usually. Each class lists its level, and our facilitators make space for beginners and experienced learners alike.

What happens after I sign up?+

We’ll send a short welcome note with the session link, what to bring, and a simple prompt to get you thinking.
